Free listings · Free messaging · No lead fees

For contractors

A storefront where the work is.

The big lead sites charge you per introduction and sell the same lead to four competitors. Crewkat's Marketplace works the other way: your listing is free, homeowners find you, and talking to them costs nothing.

  • Free business listing. Your trades, your service area, your photos — a pro profile homeowners browse when they're ready to hire.
  • Jobs posted by homeowners. Browse work posted in your area and reach out directly.
  • Free contact reveal and messaging. See the customer's contact details and message them in the app — no unlock fees, no credit packs standing between you and a conversation.
  • From chat to job in one app. When the conversation turns into work, it becomes a job — estimate, contract, and invoice without switching tools.
  • Find subs, too. Need a licensed electrician for Thursday? The Marketplace is trades talking to trades as much as homeowners hiring.

How it works

Post, get found, start working.

1

Homeowners post the job

A bathroom remodel, a fence, a paint job — described in their words, with photos, in their neighborhood.

2

Pros respond for free

Listed pros show up in search and on posted jobs. Reveal the contact, send a message, set up the estimate — no fee at any step.

3

The job runs in Crewkat

Agree on the work and it flows into the same app: estimate, signed contract, invoice, done.

For homeowners

Hiring without the phone tag.

Post your project once and let local pros come to you — or browse listed businesses by trade and area, check their photos, and message the ones you like. Your conversation stays in one thread, and when you hire, your contractor can send estimates and documents you view from a single link.

Why free works

Crewkat makes money on the software, not on you.

The Marketplace is part of the app contractors already use to run their businesses. Premium subscriptions ($19/month) fund the platform — so listings, messaging, and contact reveal don't need a toll booth. See how pricing works.

Common questions

Marketplace, answered.

Does it cost anything to get a lead?

No. Listings are free, contact reveal is free, and messaging is free. Crewkat does not sell leads.

Who can list on the Marketplace?

Contractors and trades businesses with a Crewkat account — from solo handymen to small crews. Homeowners can post jobs and browse pros.

What happens after a homeowner picks me?

Create the job in Crewkat, send the estimate from the same app, and run it like any other job — contract, portal, invoice, all connected.
